_doc: Shape of one reference analysis saved with `squint.py annotate`. Batch file = {"<ref id>": <analysis>, ...}. Use "skip" instead of an object for images that carry no design signal. Keep values short and lowercase where an enum is listed; free text only in notes/signature_moves/like_why.

r_0123456789.platform: web | ios | android | brand | print | other
r_0123456789.type: landing | dashboard | app-screen | onboarding | paywall | component | logo | identity | typography | illustration | photo | packaging | motion | other
r_0123456789.palette_notes: warm off-white + near-black, one acid accent used only for CTAs

typography.style: grotesk | neo-grotesk | geometric | humanist | serif | display-serif | mono | rounded | script | mixed
typography.notes: oversized tight-tracked headline, small mono labels

layout.grid: centered | editorial | bento | asymmetric | split | list | cards | full-bleed

r_0123456789.imagery: photo | 3d | illustration | abstract | ui-only | type-only | none
r_0123456789.motion_hint: what motion the still implies, if any
signature_moves: one sharp sentence per distinctive, reusable move
r_0123456789.like_why: best guess at what made the user save this
